title: Claude Fable 5.1 and GPT-5.6 mini join the pool
body: Both are routable today under prism/auto. Fable 5.1 lands at the top of the quality table for reasoning tasks; GPT-5.6 mini takes the fast tier's second slot behind Llama 4 Maverick.

title: Per-key spend alerts
body: Set a daily or monthly budget on any key and get an email or webhook at 50, 80 and 100 percent. Keys can now downgrade to the fast tier instead of hard-stopping when they hit the cap.

title: Policies as files
body: Routing policies can be committed to your repo as YAML and pushed with the CLI. The dashboard editor still works and writes the same format.

title: Median overhead down to 38 ms
body: The router now holds warm connections to every provider region and skips the scoring lookup for pinned models. p50 overhead dropped from 61 ms to 38 ms.

title: EU data residency
body: Team and Enterprise keys can be pinned to the Frankfurt region. Requests, logs and scoring samples never leave the EU.
